definitions.explanation: The academic field studying drugs, medicines, and their effects on the body. Includes the development, preparation, and proper use of medications.

examples.japanese: {薬学|やくがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{薬学部|やくがくぶ}→薬学部：28157_yakugakubu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六年制|ろくねんせい}になった。
examples.english: The pharmacy department has become a six-year program.

examples.japanese: {薬学|やくがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かして→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧{製薬会社|せいやくがいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a pharmaceutical company, making use of my pharmacy knowledge.

notes: Common collocations: ⟦{薬学部|やくがくぶ}→薬学部：28157_yakugakubu⟧ (pharmacy department/faculty), {薬学|やくがく}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (pharmaceutical research), {薬学|やくがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{博士号|はくしごう}→博士号：16350_hakushigou⟧ (doctorate in pharmacy). In Japan, ⟦{薬学部|やくがくぶ}→薬学部：28157_yakugakubu⟧ programs were extended from four to six years in 2006. Graduates can take the ⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧ (pharmacist) licensing exam. Part of the {〜学|がく} (study of ~) word family, like ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (medicine) and ⟦{歯学|しがく}→歯学：27622_shigaku⟧ (dentistry).
